table.name: TLGNR_COMMON_SAREA_MAP_BS
table.description: The SAP common distribution channel and common division functionality in LOGON is implemented by a Sales Area to Sales Area mapping. Entries of this table are only used for business partner CRUD operations originating from the business partner SAP interface: Reference Sales Area information (tlgns_sap_bp_sarea and BP partner function tables) is duplicated for every sales area entry in this table.

column.name: TLGNR_COMMON_SAREA_MAP_ID
column.description: PK. This is a LOGON-internal, technical identifier.

column.name: REF_SORG_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_SORG_BS. Reference sales organization. As received in the BP interface.

column.name: REF_DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
column.description: Reference distribution channel. As received in the BP interface.

column.name: REF_DIVISION_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_DIVISION_BS. Reference division. As received in the BP interface.

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_SORG_BS. To be inserted/updated/deleted additionally in the sales area composed of SORG_CD, DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL and DIVISION_CD.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
column.description: Reference distribution channel. To be inserted/updated/deleted additionally in the sales area composed of SORG_CD, DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL and DIVISION_CD.

column.name: DIVISION_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_DIVISION_BS. Reference division. To be inserted/updated/deleted additionally in the sales area composed of SORG_CD, DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL and DIVISION_CD.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
